changelog.name: v1.9.0
changelog.body:
A full bug report system inside the app, end-to-end encrypted and tied to the release that fixes it.

- **End-to-end encrypted reports.** Your message and module log are sealed on the phone with HPKE (X25519 and AES-256-GCM) and only the developer's key opens them. The server holds no private key. Questions and notes from the developer are sealed to a reply key that only your phone holds, wrapped by Android Keystore. Settings, Report a bug lists the full specs with links.
- **Follow your report.** Each report shows its status, the latest note, a Reply button while a question is open and a link to the GitHub issue once there is one.
- **Fixes you can see.** A report closes only when a release really carries the fix for its issue. That release note line is marked "Fixes your report" in the update card.
- **Opt-in.** Nothing leaves the phone until you tap Send encrypted report. Sharing hook status is now off by default, and the automatic update check has its own switch.
- **Settings.** Grouped into Updates, Support, Dashboard, Privacy and About. The module log moved to Support.
- **Dashboard.** App icons on section headers, tweak icons on rows, option rows nested inside their tweak card and an option to hide tweaks your phone cannot load.
- **Hot reload.** Each process shows its app icon and name, and the version chip appears only when a process runs an older build.
- **Motion and layout.** Shared axis screen transitions with a scaled predictive back. Sheets open below the status bar and fit short screens.

Requires Android 14 or later.

[![libxposed API 102](https://img.shields.io/badge/libxposed_API-102-ff69b4?style=flat-square)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.libxposed/api) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/hxreborn/PixelInjector?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) [![Android 14+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-14%2B-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#install) A modular Xposed module of Pixel tweaks, each behind its own switch. I built it for my own phone, but if a tweak is useful to you and breaks on your build, I can adapt or fix it on demand. - **One switch per tweak.** Off tweaks change nothing. - **Applies instantly.** Switches take effect live, and updates hot reload through libxposed API 102 with no reboot. > [!NOTE] > I build and test it on Pixel phones. On other ROMs a tweak can miss its target. For LineageOS and other ROMs with public source, I fix the tweak from that source. A closed ROM like HyperOS, One UI or ColorOS has no source to read, so the fix needs that ROM's own SystemUI or `services.jar`.
Screenshots
## Install Needs Android 14 or newer, arm64, root and an Xposed framework with libxposed API 102 (LSPosed 2.x or Vector). 1. Download the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) or the [Xposed Modules Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/eu.hxreborn.pixelinjector/releases). 2. Enable PixelInjector in your Xposed manager and select the apps of the tweaks you need in its scope. 3. Reboot once. Later updates install from the app and reload without a reboot. ## Tweaks ### System UI - **Warm Tiles**: raises the limit of [3](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/d5a204f16e7c71ffdbc6c8307a4134dcc1efd60d/packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/external/TileServices.java#37) bound tiles in Quick Settings. Same hook as [qs-boundless-tiles](https://github.com/hxreborn/qs-boundless-tiles). - **PillShot**: draws the app name on screenshots. Skips the selected apps or stamps only them. Revived from eXtreames/PillShot after its repo disappeared. - **Mute screenshot sound**: skips the screenshot shutter sound. - **Empty shade message**: replaces the empty shade's trophy and text with your own text and one of 141 icons. Android 17 only. - **Always expand notifications**: opens notifications expanded unless you collapsed one by hand. - **Pin ongoing notifications**: stops swiping away ongoing notifications like media and VPN. - **Charging details**: adds watts, volts, amps and battery temperature under the lock screen charging text. - **Download chip**: shows a download's progress as a chip in the status bar. Ported from [Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify)'s ongoing action chip. - **Fingerprint icon**: replaces the lock screen fingerprint icon with one of 34 icons from custom ROMs or your own image and can hide the circle behind it. Phones with an under-display fingerprint sensor. - **Heads-up duration**: sets how long a heads-up notification shows, from 1 to 15 seconds. - **Double tap status bar to sleep**: double tap empty status bar space and the phone sleeps. - **Biometric Bypass**: taps confirm on the biometric prompt after a face unlock and plays a system sound of your choice. Same hook as [biometric-bypass](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-bypass). ### System Framework - **Force NEW_TASK**: adds NEW_TASK to activity starts that match your rules, one `source:target` per line. - **Clipboard in background**: allows selected apps to read the clipboard in the background. ### Launcher - **Double tap to sleep**: double tap empty home screen space and the phone locks and sleeps. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Hide gesture pill**: makes the navigation handle transparent and keeps a chosen percent of the bottom inset under apps. A percent change restarts the launcher. - **Hide search bar**: hides the search bar above the hotseat and frees the row it reserves. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Hide app shortcuts**: a long press on an app shows only the system actions. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Home menu entry**: adds PixelInjector to the home screen long press menu. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. > [!WARNING] > Double tap to sleep runs `su` from Pixel Launcher. With KernelSU and APatch, grant root to Pixel Launcher by hand in the manager, not only to PixelInjector. On KernelSU it shows up after you turn on Show system apps. ### Gboard - **AMOLED black keyboard**: makes the tinted grey keyboard surfaces pure black in dark mode. Stock Gboard and the Morphe build. Toggling restarts Gboard. Same hook as [gboard-material-expressive-black](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black). ### Phone - **Remove feedback chip**: removes the Help us improve chip from the call list. Same hook as [gdialer-dechip](https://github.com/hxreborn/gdialer-dechip). ### File picker - **Force sort by newest first**: opens folders newest first in the file picker and the storage browser. Same hook as [remember-my-sort](https://github.com/hxreborn/remember-my-sort). ### KDE Connect - **KDE Connect Quiet**: stops KDE Connect from holding the Wi-Fi multicast lock. Toggling restarts KDE Connect. ### GitHub - **GH FastPass**: closes the GitHub app's approved 2FA dialog right away. Same hook as [gh-fast-pass](https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass). ## Report a bug Report from the app or on [GitHub](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/issues/new/choose), whichever you prefer. App reports are opt-in and end-to-end encrypted. Nothing leaves the phone until you tap Send. On a phone that isn't a Pixel and doesn't run an open source ROM such as LineageOS, a report about a System UI or System Framework tweak also sends that ROM's SystemUI or `services.jar` code, encrypted with the report. 1. Open Settings, tap Report a bug, say what happened and send. 2. Follow it in Your reports. My questions and the GitHub issue show there. 3. The update that fixes it says Fixes your report. Or reach me at [hxreborn@duck.com](mailto:hxreborn@duck.com) or on [Telegram](https://t.me/hxreb0rn).
Full specs | Part | Detail | | --- | --- | | Scheme | [HPKE](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180) RFC 9180 base mode | | Key exchange | DHKEM [X25519](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7748) HKDF-SHA256 | | Cipher | [AES-256-GCM](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/38/d/final) | | Encrypted | Message, module log, app versions, ROM code from phones that aren't Pixels | | Not encrypted | Phone model, build, framework. Bound to the ciphertext as [associated data](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180#section-5.2) | | Developer key | `3d76ec6a` | | Reply key | X25519 per report, wrapped by [Android Keystore](https://developer.android.com/privacy-and-security/keystore) | | Server | `reports.hxreborn.eu` holds no private key | | Redacted log data | Emails, phone numbers, IP and MAC addresses, Wi-Fi names, device and advertising IDs, storage paths, URL and header tokens ([Redactor](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/blob/main/app/src/main/kotlin/eu/hxreborn/pixelinjector/support/Redactor.kt)) | | Retention | 90 days | | Update check | On by default in Settings. A plain request every 6 hours with no device data |
## Credits - [5ec1cff/MyInjector](https://github.com/5ec1cff/MyInjector) for the module structure, the hot reload flow and the NEW_TASK rule grammar. - [tehcneko/clipboardwhitelist](https://github.com/tehcneko/clipboardwhitelist) for the clipboard hook idea. - [Mahmud0808/PixelLauncherEnhanced](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/PixelLauncherEnhanced) for the gesture pill and search bar hooks. - [Mahmud0808/Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify) for the ongoing action chip behind the download chip. - [LuckyPray/DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) for the dex search library. - [JingMatrix/Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) for the module log screen design. - [Material Symbols](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons) for the empty shade icons (Apache 2.0). - AospExtended's UdfpsResources for the fingerprint icons, taken from [Syberia](https://github.com/syberia-project/platform_vendor_syberia), [DerpFest](https://github.com/DerpFest-AOSP/vendor_derp), [AfterlifeOS](https://github.com/AfterlifeOS/packages_overlays_Themes), [Infinity-X](https://github.com/ProjectInfinity-X/packages_overlays_Themes), [AlphaDroid](https://github.com/AlphaDroid-Project/vendor_addons), [crDroid](https://github.com/crdroidandroid/android_vendor_addons) and [AospExtended](https://github.com/AospExtended/platform_vendor_aosp). ## License [![GPL-3.0-only](https://img.shields.io/badge/LICENSE-GPL--3.0--only-%23A42E2B?style=for-the-badge&logo=gnu&logoColor=white&logoPosition=right)](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/blob/main/LICENSE)
readmeZh: <图片> [![libxpose API 102](https://img.shields.io/badge/libxposed_API-102-ff69b4?style=flat-square)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.libxposed/api) [![发布](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/hxreborn/PixelInjector?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) [![Android 14+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-14%2B-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#install) Pixel 调整的模块化 Xpose 模块，每个模块都有自己的开关。我为自己的手机构建了它，但如果调整对您有用并且破坏了您的构建，我可以根据需要进行调整或修复。 - **每次调整一个开关。** 关闭调整不会改变任何内容。 - **立即应用。** 开关实时生效，并通过 libxposed API 102 更新热重载，无需重新启动。 > [!注意] > 我在 Pixel 手机上构建并测试它。在其他 ROM 上，调整可能会错过其目标。对于 LineageOS 和其他具有公共源代码的 ROM，我修复了该源代码的调整。像 HyperOS、One UI 或 ColorOS 这样的封闭 ROM 没有可供读取的源代码，因此修复需要 ROM 自己的 SystemUI 或“services.jar”。 <详情> 屏幕截图 <表> ## 安装 需要 Android 14 或更高版本、arm64、root 和带有 libxposed API 102（LSPosed 2.x 或 Vector）的 Xposed 框架。 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) 或 [Xposed Modules Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/eu.hxreborn.pixelinjector/releases) 下载 APK。 2. 在您的 Xposed 管理器中启用 PixelInjector 并在其范围内选择您需要的调整应用程序。 3. 重新启动一次。稍后的更新将从应用程序安装并重新加载，无需重新启动。 ## 调整 ### 系统界面 - **温暖图块**：提高了快速设置中 [3](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/d5a204f16e7c71ffdbc6c8307a4134dcc1efd60d/packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/external/TileServices.java#37) 绑定图块的限制。与 [qs-boundless-tiles](https://github.com/hxreborn/qs-boundless-tiles) 相同的钩子。 - **PillShot**：在屏幕截图上绘制应用程序名称。跳过选定的应用程序或仅对它们进行标记。在其存储库消失后，从 eXtreames/PillShot 中恢复。 - **静音屏幕截图声音**：跳过屏幕截图快门声音。 - **空阴影消息**：用您自己的文本和 141 个图标之一替换空阴影的奖杯和文本。仅限安卓 17。 - **始终展开通知**：打开展开的通知，除非您手动折叠通知。 - **固定持续通知**：停止清除媒体和 VPN 等持续通知。 - **充电详细信息**：在锁屏充电文本下添加瓦特、伏特、安培和电池温度。 - **下载芯片**：在状态栏中以芯片形式显示下载进度。移植自 [Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify) 的持续动作芯片。 - **指纹图标**：将锁屏指纹图标替换为自定义 ROM 中的 34 个图标之一或您自己的图像，并且可以隐藏其后面的圆圈。配备屏下指纹传感器的手机。 - **提示持续时间**：设置提示通知显示的时间长度，从 1 到 15 秒。 - **双击状态栏休眠**：双击空白状态栏空间，手机休眠。 - **生物识别绕过**：面部解锁后点击生物识别提示上的确认并播放您选择的系统声音。与 [biometric-bypass](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-bypass) 相同的钩子。 ### 系统框架 - **强制 NEW_TASK**：将 NEW_TASK 添加到与您的规则匹配的活动开始，每行一个“源：目标”。 - **后台剪贴板**：允许选定的应用程序在后台读取剪贴板。 ### 启动器 - **双击睡眠**：双击空白的主屏幕空间，手机锁定并睡眠。像素启动器和启动器3。 - **隐藏手势药丸**：使导航手柄透明并在应用程序下保留底部插入的选定百分比。百分比更改会重新启动启动器。 - **隐藏搜索栏**：隐藏热座上方的搜索栏并释放其保留的行。像素启动器和启动器3。 - **隐藏应用程序快捷方式**：长按应用程序仅显示系统操作。像素启动器和启动器3。 -
